SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.grade_key AS gradeKey, cd.codeNm AS gradeName, ps.pass_id AS passId, ps.source AS passSource, ps.total_count AS totalCount, ps.remain_count AS remainCount, ps.valid_until AS validUntil, pm.payment_id AS paymentId, pm.order_no AS orderNo, pm.paid_at AS paidAt,
ISNULL(pm.amount, pr.price) AS amount, ISNULL(pm.refund_amount, 0) AS refundAmount, pm.status AS paymentStatus, ISNULL(uc.used_count, 0) AS usedCount FROM erp_student st LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code cd ON cd.gubun = 'S' AND cd.code = st.grade_key OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 p.pass_id, p.source, p.product_id, p.total_count, p.remain_count, p.valid_until FROM erp_bookstore_pass p WHERE p.student_id = st.student_id AND p.service_code = #{serviceCode} AND p.billing_ym = #{billingYm} ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.revoked_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.granted_at DESC ) ps LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_product pr ON pr.product_id = ps.product_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 p2.payment_id, p2.order_no, p2.paid_at, p2.amount, p2.refund_amount, p2.status FROM erp_bookstore_payment p2 WHERE p2.student_id = st.student_id AND p2.service_code = #{serviceCode} AND p2.billing_ym = #{billingYm} AND p2.status IN ('PAID', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY CASE p2.status WHEN 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p2.requested_at DESC ) pm OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS used_count FROM erp_bookstore_pass_use pu WHERE pu.pass_id = ps.pass_id ) uc WHERE st.center_code = #{centerCode} AND st.status_key = 'ACTIVE'
AND st.grade_key = #{gradeKey}
AND st.student_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
ORDER BY st.student_name ASC

WITH u AS ( SELECT pu.use_id, pu.used_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pu.used_date, pu.created_at, pu.use_id) AS seq_all, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pu.used_date ORDER BY pu.created_at, pu.use_id) AS seq_in_day FROM erp_bookstore_pass_use pu WHERE pu.pass_id = #{passId} ), r AS ( SELECT rv.service_date, si.seq, si.starts_at, si.ends_at, rv.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rv.service_date ORDER BY si.seq) AS seq_in_day FROM erp_bookstore_reservation rv JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = rv.slot_instance_id WHERE rv.student_id = #{studentId} AND rv.status <> 'CANCELED' ) SELECT u.used_date AS usedDate, r.seq AS slotSeq, r.starts_at AS startsAt, r.ends_at AS endsAt, ps.total_count - u.seq_all AS remainAfter, r.status AS reservationStatus FROM u JOIN erp_bookstore_pass ps ON ps.pass_id = #{passId} LEFT JOIN r ON r.service_date = u.used_date AND r.seq_in_day = u.seq_in_day ORDER BY u.used_date DESC, u.seq_in_day DESC
SELECT student_id FROM erp_bookstore_pass WHERE pass_id = #{passId}
SELECT student_id FROM erp_bookstore_payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
